annotations.bbox_format: xyxy pixels, one compressed npz per camera view
annotations.mask_format: COCO-style uncompressed RLE in gzip JSONL, one record per rendered video frame per camera view
annotations.video_overlay: all retained mp4 videos include 2D boxes and translucent pixel-mask overlays

mesh_assets.requirement: the saved mesh assets are part of the dataset and are used by replay validation/import tooling

state_import_contract.physical_properties: mass, center of mass, inertia diagonal, friction/contact metadata, force/torque disturbance metadata where applicable
state_import_contract.pose_format: world position xyz plus quaternion wxyz per simulation step
state_import_contract.velocity_format: world linear velocity xyz and angular velocity xyz per simulation step
